summary: Immersion Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events reporting that the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request to continue listing contingent on demonstrating compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) by May 22, 2026, following a delinquency notice for failure to file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended January 31, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory update on a listing condition, not a special situation event. No deal terms are present.
